caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, intricately detailed round object mounted on a wide, flat base with a central knob-like pedestal. The circular part shows a carved design of a bird, resembling an eagle with spread wings, surrounded by blades of grass or stylized foliage, and a six-pointed star (hexagram) above its head. The circular section is bordered by a repeated notched or triangular pattern. The shading and hatching indicate shadows and texture, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. The artist's signature, "Frances Lichten," is visible to the right of the base. The composition is rendered in black ink on a light or off-white background.
title: Pa. German Butter Stamp
